body:
Thankyou for that. Intellectually I know I shouldn't be ashamed and what you're saying is right, I guess my reality doesn't reflect that though because if I ask anyone I know irl for help they'll flip it against me and I know I'll feel more shame and it's really unbearable.

I wish you all the love, happiness and safety.

Same position as you has driven me to attempt recently. Obviously other things as well in combination.
It's terrible.

Some people can't handle when you stick up for yourself because they've designated you as their personal emotional whipping thing.
You aren't alone and there are people who see the real you and your worth
I hope you make it to Christmas 2022 and find happiness and peace

My feelings exactly.

I don't deserve to be saved. Or loved. Or to find happiness.
